title: Adjunction
description: JSON Schema for an adjunction L -| R between two functors L: C -> D and R: D -> C (Kan 1958; Mac Lane 1971 Ch. IV). The data is the pair of adjoint functors plus the unit and counit natural transformations witnessing the adjunction. The triangle identities — (R epsilon) compose (eta R) = id_R and (epsilon L) compose (L eta) = id_L — are universally-quantified equations checked by adjunction-axiom transformers, not by JSON Schema.

left-adjoint.description: The name of the left adjoint functor L: C -> D.

right-adjoint.description: The name of the right adjoint functor R: D -> C.

unit.description: The name of the unit natural transformation eta: Id_C => R compose L.

counit.description: The name of the counit natural transformation epsilon: L compose R => Id_D.
